goal_intent: book dinner for three and mention it is a birthday

turns.utterance: Hi there! I’m calling to make a dinner reservation for a little family celebration this week.
It’ll be three of us, just a small gathering. We’re really looking forward to a nice evening out together!
We’d love to come in on Friday, since it’s a special occasion. It should be a lovely way to kick off the weekend!
We were hoping for 8pm, if that’s available. That gives us all a chance to get ready and enjoy the evening properly!
That’s perfect, thank you! Please put it under Priya Raman. Also, it’s my mother’s birthday—would it be possible to have a candle on her dessert to make it a bit more special?

That’s wonderful, thank you so much for making it special for her! That’s everything we need—I really appreciate your help. 

[END OF CALL]
